name: Pons V2
description: Pons is a token launchpad for creating and trading fixed-supply tokens that progress toward liquidity graduation on Robinhood Chain

methodology.Volume: Volume of all swaps on Pons' launch curve, external uniswap v4 swaps are excluded
methodology.Fees: Includes launch fees, curve swap fees and swap fees post graduation (uniswap v4 : realised through fee swept events)
methodology.Revenue: Includes all the launch fees and part of swap fees
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Includes swap fees to creators, taxes (optional) to creators and buybacks (if enabled by creators) of meme tokens

Fees.Launch Fees: 0.0005 ETH charged for each token launched
Fees.Curve Swap Fees: Fees and taxes collected from curve swaps on Pons' launch curve
Fees.Token Swap Fees: Fees and taxes collected from uniswap v4 swaps on graduated pools (realised through fee swept events)

Revenue.Launch Fees to Protocol: All the launch fees (0.0005 ETH per token launched) collected goes to the protocol
Revenue.Curve Swap Fees to Protocol: Part of (30% for most pools) the curve swap fees collected goes to the protocol
Revenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: Part of (30% for most pools) the uniswap v4 swap fees collected goes to the protocol

SupplySideRevenue.Curve Swap Fees to Creators: Part of (70% when buyback is disabled, 35% when buyback is enabled) the curve swap fees collected goes to the creators
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Creators: Part of (70% when buyback is disabled, 35% when buyback is enabled) the uniswap v4 swap fees collected goes to the creators
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax: Taxes collected from creators (if enabled) on curve swaps
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Meme Token Buybacks: Part of (0% when buyback is disabled, 35% when buyback is enabled) the uniswap v4 swap fees collected goes to the buyback and burning of meme tokens
